ImageDescription.value: The town of Barrow, Alaska—the northernmost city in the United States— seen from the NASA P-3B during an IceBridge survey flight on Mar. 24, 2013. During this mission the IceBridge team flew over a field research site near Barrow, gathering data at the same time scientists on the ground were measuring snow depth and ice thickness. Collaboration of this nature is one of IceBridge's science requirements.

ImageDescription.value: Film photograph of a whalebone arch in Utqiagvik, Alaska. Utqiagvik was formerly heavily reliant on whaling for sustenance, and this whalebone arch is right on the waterfront where whalers would return from hunts.
